prs.title: Fix repeated renewal alerts and safe stale-book waiting
prs.body:
The monitor recorded base issues before renewal checks and complete issues afterward, causing unchanged paused/renewal-blocked incidents to alternate fingerprints and enqueue two emails per poll. Record the complete incident only after all checks; a two-poll integration test verifies a single durable notification.

Past stale PAS book timestamps now wait only on active pre-decision/pre-intent ticks after other snapshot checks and pending-order reconciliation. The existing book-age threshold is unchanged and stale quotes cannot be used for orders. Ownership/loss checks and authorization remain mandatory. Fresh captures recover within the original decision window; future timestamps, operator/startup pauses, account faults and post-submit uncertainty remain hard failures. PAR remains unchanged.

Validation: 114 relevant tests passed (one Windows symlink skip); repository Ruff passed. Eight added tests cover complete-incident dedup, fresh recovery, no catch-up, future timestamps, account faults, expiry/revocation, operator races and post-submit stale quotes.

prs.title: Add line breaks and indentation to PAS email bodies
prs.body:
PAS email bodies currently arrive as a single JSON line. Pretty-print JSON with two-space indentation at the email presentation boundary, preserving the stored outbox payload and existing English field names/content. Non-JSON bodies retain their original formatting. Trading, renewal decisions and notification queue semantics are unchanged.

Validation: 30 existing PAS launch/renewal tests passed; Ruff passed. Deploy only the independent monitor.

prs.title: Add opt-in healthy PAS approval renewal and durable email notices
prs.body:
An explicitly installed standing permission can renew the same PAS trading grant for 24 hours within its final 15 minutes, without daily operator messages. The unsigned monitor checks the exact policy/account identity, fresh public preflight, active trader heartbeat, no waits or pending orders/requests, position/risk/margin consistency, email availability and exchange authorization covering the new grant. Expired grants and paused traders are never auto-resumed; leverage and strategy parameters are unchanged.

An optional compose overlay mounts the standing permission read-only and grants the public-only monitor write access to the bounded trading approval directory. The monitor receives no API key. Grant publication is atomic/fsynced and serialized against trader pauses and intent creation. A recovery journal and idempotent durable outbox record each successful renewal and retry email delivery; messages identify the new expiry and unchanged limits.

Validation: 14 renewal fault/boundary tests passed; 103 relevant tests passed before the final three added renewal cases (one Windows symlink skip); repository Ruff passed. Full Linux CI required before merge. Existing opt-out behavior remains the default.

prs.title: Recover transient PAS public-query outages before order intent
prs.body:
Transient public-info timeouts, connection failures and HTTP 408/429/500/502/503/504 previously latched PAS trading until operator recovery. Active PAS ticks now wait and recapture fresh evidence only before decision/intent creation, after pending-order reconciliation. Recovery checks local approval, exchange authorization, account consistency and market risk, and respects the original decision window and idempotency.

Unknown or post-submit outcomes, operator requests, manual/startup pauses, authorization failures, TLS errors and other HTTP statuses remain hard failures. Notifications distinguish network waiting from spread waiting. Diagnostics persist only allowlisted query names and status codes; no request/response payloads. Strategy, limits, approval duration and collector/research data are unchanged.

Validation: 92 relevant offline tests passed (one Windows symlink skip); repository Ruff passed. Added 13 tests covering retry classification, safe recovery, expiry/revocation, manual pause races, restart, PAR behavior and post-submit uncertainty. Full Linux CI required before merge.

prs.title: Automatically wait and recover from pre-order PAS spread limits
prs.body:
Transient wide spread previously latched a manual pause even before any order was submitted. Add a PAS-only market_wait state: each poll re-captures and validates non-spread market rules, account/position/loss constraints, local approval expiry and exchange authorization. Return to normal operation only when the unchanged spread limit passes. Waiting creates no decision or intent; recovery outside the normal window skips trading rather than catching up.

Manual/startup/restart pauses, account and authorization failures, loss stops and unknown/partial/post-submit reconciliation remain hard pauses. Atomic wait transitions cannot clear concurrent operator pauses; restart still requires explicit resume. There is no approval renewal, forced flatten or PAR behavior change. The optional JSON-state field requires no table migration or policy-identity change.

Validation: 14 new spread-wait boundary/concurrency tests, 49 Funding tests (one Windows symlink skip), 16 PAS launch tests and Ruff passed locally. All three required CI jobs passed, then merged with the tested head pinned. [Passing CI](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/39452979055).

Spread limit, maximum notional, signal and decision clock remain unchanged. Detailed deployment, backup and recovery evidence is maintained separately from this code review.

prs.title: Fix transient collateral hold false pauses with one full public recapture
prs.body:
Independent spot and position queries can observe different marks, causing a legitimate own cross-margin hold to exceed the captured position margin and incorrectly latch a pause. For that narrow case, capture the entire public snapshot once more and use only the fresh result. Existing tolerance, full validation and account/position ownership checks remain unchanged. Persistent unexplained holds, foreign orders/positions, flat accounts and negative holds remain blocked; a failed recapture never reuses stale data. Rejected public account endpoints remain in observation evidence.

Seven regression tests cover the reproduced race, PAS path, persistent excess, foreign/negative/flat/changing-account boundaries, failed capture, fresh Funding/book/free-margin reuse and foreign orders appearing during recapture. Local Funding suite: 49 tests (one Windows-specific symlink skip); PAS launch suite: 16 passed; Ruff passed.

prs.title: Deploy SSH CSV exporter on Python 3.14 without trading SDK dependencies
prs.body:
The VPS already has Python 3.14, while installing the root trading project requires Python <3.14 and pulls in the trading SDK. Package only the SSH CSV export runtime as an independent stdlib-only wheel for a dedicated Python 3.14 venv, without installing Python 3.12 or the trading project.

The deterministic stdlib builder copies unchanged export/research/venue modules into alpha_csv_export and extracts the exact two constants and two normalization helpers required from venue_collection. It excludes Collector/Capture, HTTP client, ProcessLock, wallet and SDK code; static import checks reject new non-stdlib or unbundled dependencies. The wheel has its own Python >=3.14,<3.15 metadata, source SHA256 manifest and RECORD hashes, with no Requires-Dist. Root pyproject.toml retains >=3.11,<3.14; Collector/trading/risk source is unchanged.

The SSH launcher uses the independent namespace. Deployment documentation explicitly installs python3.14-venv and acl, builds/installs the reviewed wheel with --no-index --no-deps into a root-owned export-only venv, checks -I imports and dependencies, and retains account/ACL/SSH acceptance plus rollback guidance. requests is fixture-harness-only and is not installed in the deployment venv.

Validation at head 0815dab89ebc8015a21b3b87642453b953abd482: CI run #167 SUCCESS; all three jobs passed:
- Standalone CSV Python 3.14 / WAL / SSH: clean wheel install without external runtime dependencies, all 15 installed-wheel tests, background concurrent WAL writer/checkpoint during CSV output, prefix isolation, filters/panel parity, locks/timeout, artifact hashes/dependency boundaries, and real SSH/PAM acceptance through the installed Python 3.14.4 interpreter.
- Disposable SSH CSV permission isolation: existing supported-runtime SSH acceptance retained and passed.
- Server container / Python 3.12.15: full original regression/contracts/data/risk/Paper and container fault/recovery checks passed.

Local WSL Python 3.14.4 / SQLite 3.46.1 installed-wheel suite also passed all 15 tests. Related Python 3.12 tests, Ruff and whitespace checks passed.

No VPS connections/modifications, Collector changes, merge or deployment. This PR prepares the artifact and tests only. Existing large-history scan/time-limit behavior is unchanged; actual VPS installation and public-key/ACL/WAL acceptance remain a separate step.

prs.title: Add restricted read-only SSH CSV export for PAS research
prs.body:
Team members need PAS history without server administration or deployment access. This adds a fixed-path read-only SSH CSV exporter reusing pas_research normalization and causal minute-panel logic. Supports --all or UTC half-open --from/--to, --symbol, observations/funding/minute-panel and optional raw JSON, streaming stdout with short SQLite reads, flock and resource limits.

Deployment uses a managed EOF Match block in the main sshd_config, an idempotent stdin/stdout renderer with removal support, candidate validation and administrator effective-config comparison. Dedicated system accounts use unusable '*' password hashes and publickey-only SSH, with root-owned code/keys and read-only data access. Installation, rollback and later VPS acceptance are documented.

Parser regression repair, based on actual CI output:
- Diagnostic commit 3374bd1 reproduced the original failure and printed invalid.returncode=0, invalid.stdout='', invalid.stderr=''. The historical included configuration was accepted; this was an incorrect test expectation, not mismatched error wording.
- OpenSSH restores outer Include context, and the measured Match-all same-file sample is accepted on Ubuntu OpenSSH 9.6 as well. Preserve both as positive cases, with sshd -T checks comparing exporter restrictions and unchanged administrator settings.
- Keep an actual negative control: UsePAM directly inside a named Match User block. It must fail with nonzero status and diagnostics identifying the test file, UsePAM and Match. Final CI reports returncode=255 and the expected context rejection. All three cases print return code, stdout and stderr.
- Real UsePAM=yes SSH tests also exposed lingering disposable PAM/user-manager processes. Cleanup now terminates sessions/processes only for test-created non-root accounts, waits for exit and requires successful userdel. It does not force deletion or suppress cleanup failure; PASS is printed only after cleanup completes.
- Correct the deployment guide's earlier overbroad claim that the include layout must fail. EOF placement remains this project's explicit managed-install policy, rather than a claimed universal parser requirement.

Validation at final head dc23eecfc7b76eb75b0b1b3cd148ea4ceaab3f06: CI run #164 SUCCESS, both 'Disposable SSH CSV permission isolation' and 'Server container / Python 3.12.15' passed. This covers actual Ubuntu main configuration and PAM, administrator publickey shell access, three CSV datasets/range filters, command/SFTP/SCP/password/PTY/forwarding denial, read-only permissions, strict session cleanup, full regression/contracts/data/risk/Paper checks and container backup/recovery/fault exercises. Local related suite: 31 tests (29 passed, 2 Linux-only skips); Ruff and diff whitespace checks passed.

Known limits: unindexed history/time paging and Python normalization scans can hit the 5-second query or 300-second export limits; no production-scale history benchmark is claimed. Prefix consistency assumes append-only history, partial CSV failures must be discarded, and actual VPS PAM/account policy/ACL/WAL behavior requires later onsite acceptance.

No Collector, raw database/schema, trading or risk code changes. No VPS connections, account creation, merge or deployment. Keep this PR open; do not auto-merge.

prs.title: Research: basis direction, convergence and official funding evidence
prs.body:
Tests whether oracle-basis deviations predict profitable price direction, rather than assuming convergence or a five-minute hold is sufficient. Adds independent offline convergence and direction studies; no trading strategy is enabled or reversed, and no stop/take-profit parameters are selected. Keep draft.

Reports:
- [Direction, matched execution, MAE/MFE and official-history audit](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/codex/reference-basis-research/docs/research/basis-direction-2026-10-17/report.zh-CN.md)
- [Convergence / breakeven / profit-target first-passage study](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/blob/codex/reference-basis-research/docs/research/basis-convergence-2026-10-17/report.zh-CN.md)

Data and implementation:
- Frozen 50,050 real BTC/ETH testnet snapshots; 50,044 valid rows, six invalid reference-time rows and 44 continuity breaks. Raw data stays local; archived event/observation evidence, complete CSVs, hashes and PNG/SVG figures are included.
- Episodes require a prior observed reset; repeated snapshots within one deviation are not independent onsets. Convergence study: 10/20/50 bps triggers, +/-2/5 bps bands, 1/3/5/10/30/60 minute horizons, explicit censoring, KM counts/bounds and exploratory date-block intervals.
- Direction audit uses frozen onsets without selecting successful convergences, +/-2 bps reset only. Separates signal-origin from next-quote-origin forward returns, signed-basis IC from magnitude/payoff correlation, and mid moves from tradable bid/ask payoffs.
- Original, opposite, always-long and always-short comparisons use the same events/quotes/quantity and require both sides' entry/exit depth in the paired cohort. Opposite net PnL is computed from its own bid/ask, never a negation. No trade is the zero baseline. Full distributions, per-day results, leave-one-day-out/outlier sensitivity and sampled MAE/MFE are archived.
- Actual official read-only requests obtained 217 hourly fundingHistory records per asset (434 total), complete requested hour buckets. Signed historical-rate funding cashflow uses the last eligible local oracle as a settlement-value approximation, not actual account payments or historical input availability.
- Official recentTrades returned 10 per asset; only three BTC trades overlap the frozen local window, none for ETH. Retain only market fields, omit participant lists. An unsigned HEAD of the documented S3 asset-context object returned 403; testnet/par archive existence/coverage remains unconfirmed. No candles downloaded, credentials loaded or requester-pays download performed.
- Correct prior prototype defaults to 9 bps taker/side, BTC/ETH quantity step 0.0001 and minimum entry value 10. Account-specific historical fees/rules remain unverified.
- The branch also contains a separately committed collector poll configuration change from 30s to 5s. This analysis still uses the frozen approximately 30s sample; no newer collected prices are passed off as fresh validation. This research task did not deploy or change server services.

Main directional findings (>=20 bps onsets):
- From the next quote, 5m outcomes are available for 179 episodes: 122 original-direction moves, 38 opposite moves, 19 flat. Original hit rate 68.2%; signed-basis/forward-mid Pearson -0.329, Spearman -0.378. Association favors reversion in seen data, not a direction-mapping bug.
- Absolute initial deviation vs favorable 5m move has Pearson +0.098 and an exploratory date-block interval crossing zero; larger deviations are not proven more profitable.
- Only 17 episodes have retained signals and paired entry/exit depth at 5m. Original ideal mid movement +8.83 bps becomes -0.05 bps at executable touch quotes, then -22.10 bps after costs; opposite net is -39.76 bps. Original net-positive exits 3/17, opposite 0/17. Official funding-rate scenario: -22.05/-39.71 bps.
- Original/reverse paired mean net is negative at every studied horizon. Leave-one-day-out and largest-move diagnostics do not turn the directional association into a positive-cost strategy.
- Paired 5m sampled net MAE medians are -28.42/-45.65 bps; MFE medians zero. Unclamped best net value is separately retained so MFE=0 is not misrepresented as an observed breakeven exit.
- Earlier convergence result remains: 180 onsets, 10m/60m KM convergence 55.8%/88.4%, median 8.22m. Financial/price cohorts and time origins differ; do not combine their denominators or PnL means.

Validation: 62 basis/cost/convergence/direction tests; with existing forecast architecture/adapter/interfaces, 112 relevant tests pass. Ruff, diff and evidence/method/official hashes pass. All 810 direction group point summaries exactly reproduced from 9,985 archived observations; figures visually checked. Existing Windows Paper full-suite process-exit limitation remains; full regression is not claimed green. Linux CI runs separately.

All Oct 8-17 prices have already been seen. These are sampled retrospective associations/opportunities, not guaranteed fills, account returns, causal proof, fresh out-of-sample validation or hedged arbitrage. No merge or deployment.

- 覆盖提交前/后 os._exit 硬退出、终态反馈原子性、并发写/唯一成交、部分/反向/多腿/unknown/取消、成本预算回滚、quote/step/epoch变化、原始 Forecast与政策绑定、暂停/权益/会话/授权跨重启、v3→v4与模式隔离。

prs.title: PR6：历史市场风险估计与冻结输入离线回放
prs.body:
## 结果与范围
新增独立市场统计模块：同一冻结窗口上的 simple returns、均值、波动率、N 资产样本协方差与相关性。使用显式有序资产集合及研究配置，pin 一次 asof/sequence/anchor，封存实际历史响应、配置和结果；支持删除源数据库后离线复算及摘要/版本校验。

prs.title: PR4：固定快照的多轮历史 Data Gateway 与证据封存
prs.body:
PR4 将 PR2 的 HTTP Agent 通信与 PR3 历史市场数据连接：同一 AnalysisJob 内可多轮请求不同窗口/资产/字段，随后提交原 ForecastBatch。基于已合并 main fd650ee，默认历史演示为 Shadow，不生成执行 Decision。

### 实现
- 固定 Job 创建时的 asof、历史 snapshot_seq 和 observation anchor，同毫秒的新入库也不能进入旧 Job；Gateway 只读本地预热历史，不在任务中联网补抓。
- 可信 producer/version/role capability 区分读取与预测资产，限制 source/kind/fields/interval/window；认证与 lease 分离，查询前后重检 lease、权限、控制版本、输入及分析时限。
- Job 全生命周期 Dataset ID 定义不可变；request_id 按 attempt 幂等；跨 attempt 复用内容但必须重新授权读取才能引用。查询数、完整 response+request+provenance 字节跨 attempt 累计，与 fixture 共用预算；alias 也有上限。
- 不只看 history.status：同时检查 gaps/invalid/truncated/未收盘/完整窗口/新鲜度。仅完整 ready 响应有 evidence_ref；stale+gap 保留诊断；旧 DTO 无 partial，因此不完整映射为非 ready，原 13 DTO 和七份业务 Schema 不变。
- 接受事务合并当前 attempt 证据，复用既有 Ingress 校验，并与 Submission/Job 终态/Outbox 一并保存 accepted_manifest。Outbox 使用封存内容，不能仅以 asof 重查可变数据。
- 可选 --history-database / Worker --history：两个独立进程、两窗口、Shadow-only；拒绝混用旧 control Runtime/Decision journal；不调用 Mock Consumer 执行。旧 PR2 fixture/Mock 模式保留。

### 验证
- 本地 Python 3.12.15：**235 项 unittest 全通过**（旧 208 + 新 27）。
- 新测试覆盖真正 HTTP、Core/Worker 独立进程、第一轮后杀 Worker 并重启 Core、缓存响应提交后硬退出、同毫秒快照、跨 attempt 证据、query/submit 竞争、权限撤销、控制切换、并发总额与字节预算、摘要/锚点损坏及 v2→v3 迁移。
- Ruff、七份业务 Schema/13 Transport 样例、运行环境/31 pinned dependencies、PR3 离线实样、原 dry-run/LT Adapter 均通过。
- 本机实际 HTTP 读取 PR3 保存的公开 BTC 5 根、ETH 10 根：捕获已超出演示新鲜度，两者正确 stale，无 evidence_ref，Dummy abstain 并收到 SHADOW_ONLY，Decision=null；没有放宽参数或重新抓取行情。
- CI 保留原两容器 Mock 闭环并新增 --history 两容器 Shadow 验收：Core 独占空历史库、两轮明确 missing、abstain、manifest 封存、容器重启后证据保留且零 Mock Decision。空库验收与本机 ready/真实捕获 stale 路径分别报告。已在本提交两轮 GitHub Actions 实跑通过：[push](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/38902780353)、[PR](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/38902841770)。日志确认 Ran 235 tests / OK、原 Mock 两容器通过，以及 Shadow Gateway: two rounds, explicit missing, sealed manifest, zero Mock Decisions after restart。

### 迁移与边界
Runtime schema 2→3 新增五张 Gateway/manifest 表；历史 schema 1、Mock journal、Forecast 0.1 和旧调用返回语义保留。回滚先停新入口并保留 DB/spool；旧 runtime 拒绝 schema 3，不能清库强制降级。

Gateway 本版接入 candle，metadata 继续由 PR3 维护。没有真实 LLM/账户/风险估计/订单、扫描器或 VPS 部署；长期历史仍需持续采集，跨 VPS TLS、WAL/磁盘/备份运维、真实 order intent/reconcile 按后续阶段独立处理。

运行命令、能力和预算、response digest、质量映射、跨 attempt/竞态、迁移/回滚及未解决边界见 [PR4 文档](docs/dynamic-data-gateway-pr4.zh-CN.md)。只提交审核，不自动合并。

prs.title: PR2：Core 与 Dummy Agent 双进程 HTTP 通信闭环
prs.body:
Trading Core 与 Dummy Agent 现在可以作为独立 Python 程序，通过有身份认证的 HTTP 完成 Scheduler → AnalysisJob → 固定 fixture 查询 → ForecastBatch → Portfolio → DemoRiskGate → MockExecution → Feedback。严格限定 PR2，不连接真实 LLM、不发送交易订单，不部署 VPS。

### 实现与兼容
- 复用 PR0 的 agent-transport/0.1 DTO、Forecast 0.1 和既有校验，复用 PR1 SQLite 事务、Scheduler、幂等与 Outbox。
- 服务端 token 映射可信身份，检查 Worker 所有权、路由/lease 一致性；限制 body、JSON 深度、连接时长、并发、轮询和查询预算。
- Worker 原子保存 claim ID 和完整提交后再发送；超时重放原内容，重启先查询原任务反馈，独立续租。
- 消费端再次检查控制 epoch、水位与过期；执行前冻结稳定 Decision、输入和模拟配置版本。Mock 提交后反馈落库前崩溃时，先对账既有 Mock report，再恢复 Outbox，避免重复执行。unknown 暂停自动工作。
- 独立容器/volume/凭证挂载；测试网络 internal、无公网端口、无外网服务依赖。CI 新增实际双容器闭环与 Core 容器重启验收。
- 原七份业务 Schema、同步 Forecast/LT Adapter、collect/dry-run 保留；旧测试只将 schema version 断言更新到增量版本。

### 验证
- 本地 Python 3.12.15：**176 项 unittest 全通过**（152 项既有 + 24 项 PR2）。
- 新测试包含真实 HTTP 并发、已提交但 HTTP 超时、重复/换 ID 提交、权限与撤销、查询预算竞争、控制切换、水位与到期、Core 重启、Worker 硬退出恢复、Mock 执行后反馈前硬退出、冻结配置/Decision 恢复。
- Ruff、7 JSON Schema 与样例、Transport bundle/13 DTO 样例、服务器运行环境/31 pinned dependencies 均通过；uv pip check 通过。
- 原 dry-run 与 LT adapter 离线演练通过。
- 本地 Docker Linux daemon 未启动；已由 GitHub Actions 实际验证 Linux 双容器闭环及 Core 容器重启，均通过。
- 当前提交 c04fe57 的 push / pull_request 两轮 CI 全部成功：[push](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/38844126311)、[PR](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/38844166225)。日志确认 176 tests / OK、two_containers=passed、Mock Decision survived Core container restart。

### 迁移、运行与边界
Runtime schema 1→2 在原迁移事务中新增 mock_configurations、mock_plans、fixture_queries 三张表，已验证旧数据保留。Mock journal 格式不变。回滚停用新入口并保留 DB/spool；PR1 不直接打开 schema 2，不能清库或自动降级消除已接受/执行事实。

运行命令、API/错误码、凭证、故障策略及迁移/回滚说明见 [PR2 文档](docs/http-loop-pr2.zh-CN.md)。所有价格、账户和阈值是合成测试配置。历史数据/任意动态 Gateway/真实账户/量化风险/生产执行恢复仍属后续 PR3–PR8；Jev、新闻及事件扫描器未开发。此 PR 只提交审核，不自动合并。

prs.title: PR1: SQLite AnalysisJob、Scheduler 与事务 Outbox 恢复
prs.body:
将 PR0 的纯任务契约落到真实文件 SQLite：Forecast 接受时在 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 事务中重新读取身份、Job、租约、控制 epoch 和水位，一次性提交 Submission、Job 终态、Processing、Outbox 与审计，避免并发预校验产生重复处理。

实现：
- 独立版本化 runtime DB（WAL/FULL/外键）、每操作独立连接、锁后可信时间、迁移与容量边界。
- Job 原子领取、续租、终态竞争、过期/尝试耗尽恢复；数据库唯一约束确保 Worker/控制范围串行。
- 持久 claim/Submission/Batch/complete 身份与回执重放；新 submission ID 重发同 Batch 仍只生成一个处理单元。
- Scheduler tick 去重与最新触发合并，provider 在写锁外构建冻结 Context，锁内再次复查才创建 Job。
- Outbox 投递预留、delivery epoch fencing、同 processing_id 恢复；预留/完成时复查控制版本、水位和时效。

验证：
- 原 94 项保留，新增 58 项，共 152 项 unittest 本地通过。
- 9 类独立进程竞争场景、6 个 os._exit 硬退出窗口；另测 SQL 中途失败、锁等待跨 lease 截止、迁移回滚、备份恢复和时钟回拨。
- Ruff、原七业务 Schema、Transport bundle/13 消息样例、Python 3.12.15/31 锁定依赖核对与 uv pip check 通过。
- 原 dry-run 和 LT Dummy smoke 均 simulated/completed；PR0/业务契约与 Schema、签名工具和部署配置未改动。

边界：没有 HTTP/凭证认证服务/Agent Worker、常驻 Core 或 Portfolio/Risk/Execution 调用；不部署、不调用真实 LLM、不发送订单。Outbox.recover 仅在旧 Core/消费者已停止后使用，单活动 Core 的进程启动所有权由 PR2 落地；本 PR 不保证外部 exactly-once。PR2 仍须在副作用前复查版本/水位并冻结稳定 Decision/policy/config 身份；PR4 仍负责真实数据响应摘要、来源/权限与质量。

详细实现与恢复/回滚说明：docs/runtime-jobs-pr1.zh-CN.md。

prs.title: PR0: Agent Transport 0.1 契约与 Forecast Ingress 校验
prs.body:
为独立 Agent/Core 接入固定可测试的任务、租约、处理状态与消息边界，避免将预测合法性、持久化接受及交易完成混为一谈。

- 无副作用的 Forecast Ingress：验证认证主体绑定、租约、控制 epoch/接受水位、冻结 manifest、可信时间及现有 Forecast 语义；error 整批阻断，Shadow 不进入 Portfolio。
- 抽取纯 Context/Forecast 校验供原 checked_forecast 与 Ingress 共用；保留 LT 现有签名、fixture/严格模式和原校验时钟顺序。
- 文档明确 ID/幂等规则、HTTP 映射，以及 PR1 事务与 PR2 网络实现职责。

- Ruff、原七份业务 Schema/样例、独立 Transport bundle 与 13 类消息样例验证通过。
- 原 dry-run 与独立 LT Dummy 两条离线 smoke run 均 simulated/completed。
- Python 3.12.15 与 31 个锁定运行依赖核对通过，uv pip check 兼容性通过。
- 确认原业务契约、七份 Schema、签名工具与部署配置无变更；远端容器 CI 见 Checks。

范围边界：本 PR 不实现 SQLite/Outbox/Scheduler/HTTP 服务/Worker，不签发已持久化接受回执，不部署、不调用真实 LLM 或发送订单。validate_ingress 仅为预校验；PR1 必须事务性复查并保存结果+Outbox 后，PR2 才能返回 HTTP 202。真实数据库并发幂等、重放恢复与双进程通信分别留 PR1/PR2 验收。

prs.title: Stabilize Forecast integration v0.2.1 for independent LT adapters
prs.body:
当前边界将 ForecastBatch.created_ms 强制等同于 Context.asof_ms，并只汇总第一个内置 Producer 的数据需求，导致带推理延迟的 LT Adapter 及独立数据需求无法正确集成。本改动保持 Architecture v0.2 和全部现有线协议，修复四项 P0：

- 区分冻结信息时点、生成完成时间和可信接收/消费时刻，检查输入年龄、推理返回预算与预测有效期，保留结构化失败。
- AgentAdapter 与 ForecastProducer 统一为 ID、版本、requirements()、forecast() 四项边界。
- 增加显式 ProducerRegistry 白名单，拒绝重复 ID、版本冲突和身份漂移，保留唯一控制版本。
- 汇总全部启用版本的 DataRequest，完全相同去重、同 ID 异义拒绝；各版本读取独立视图，控制版本先消费，影子数据缺失/延迟不阻断控制执行。

附独立的 DummyLTProducer（不继承 Rule/Mock）、8 秒虚拟推理延迟及 BTC bid/ask + ETH funding 请求示例。原 CLI 与 config/dry-run.toml 保持可用，CI 追加 LT 示例 smoke run。

兼容性：forecast/0.1、DataRequest/Decision/ExecutionReport 1.0、RiskSnapshot/RiskVerdict 的字段和 JSON Schema 均未变更；interfaces.Strategy 保留。未触及真实签名执行、交易授权或服务器采集部署。

验证：
- 先提交 50b37e9：首批 14 项新增回归在 main c6ca2ab 上失败，然后实施修复。
- 原 35 项保留，最终 57 项 unittest 全通过；Ruff、七份 Schema/样例、Python 3.12.15 与 31 项锁定依赖检查通过。
- 默认 Dry Run 和独立 DummyLT 多资产完整链路通过；服务器同镜像的分支 CI 和 PR 合并预览 CI 均全部通过。

- [PR CI：全部通过](https://github.com/BouillieAnonymous/Perpetual-Alpha-2026/actions/runs/38727597440)

限制：推理预算在同步 Adapter 返回时拒绝迟到结果，不会强杀阻塞调用；真实 Harness 需自行配置有限 I/O 超时。没有真实 LLM、交易、生产风险模型、回测或订单恢复验收。模拟成功不代表真实自动交易已通过验收。
